items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: there's a picture of me and student director and I have also a write up--Dr. Thurston Adams. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, you're shaking hands with him.

ctx.x: So Burns said you can't miss this opportunity to get a terrific man like this, to play that homecoming, and he decided some kind of way that he would--Burns even told him where we would be--at that time I don't think he knew where we would be, I think he told him some kind of lie to where we'd be and it would be so far they'd have to fly us in, they'd have to pay more money to fly us in, and he got that extra money and we got that homecoming dance; there's a picture of me and student director and I have also a…
